text: adubio is an assurance intelligence product, not simply an AI document checker. Its public knowledge areas include continuous assurance, real-time audit observations, evidence requests and responses, business agreement and disagreement workflows, regulatory and policy traceability, evidence verification, workpaper generation and review, findings management, reasoning provenance, and synthetic financial institution testing. These are areas to discuss, not a guarantee of current licensed feature availability. Confirm deployment capabilities through enquiries@qlogue.com.
